verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Crossmint's REST APIs, an interactive API reference, and payment flows that use third-party clients (@x402/core, mppx). No item documents an official Crossmint SDK package or library. REST endpoints and protocol clients are building blocks rather than official SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.
